case_number: 2025 INSC 343; CIVIL APPEAL NO. ________ OF 2025 (@SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 9472 OF 2023)
summary: Rejection of plaint on limitation; limitation commences from date of conveyances (2004–2009), not cancellation of power of attorney (2015); prior valid conveyances unaffected by subsequent cancellation; High Court error in treating cancellation as cause of action; Trial Court's rejection upheld; suit to declare sale deeds null and void barred by limitation.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; rejection of plaint affirmed.
